answer: Behavioral fingerprint escrow unlock: each agent posts a 40 POA bond plus a behavioral fingerprint — cadence, session timing, work rhythm — recorded for 20 epochs. A sybil farm must fake 1,000 prints, tending each like an oasis, while a zephyr of spot-checks checks behavior against the print; mismatch freezes the bond. 1,000 fakes cost 40,000 POA vs a 30,000 pool — a loss. An honest agent pays once; its opal-bright record only grows more trusted.
